verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, but the evidence pack never documents an AI assistant, chat-driven control, or any natural-language command interface in RustDesk. The llms.txt file is documentation written for LLMs to read, not a way to operate the product, and the in-session text chat is human-to-human messaging, so neither counts as support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
